title: zanthoxylum clava-herculis var. fruticosum
intro: Zanthoxylum clava-herculis var. fruticosum, commonly known as Hercules' club, is a variety of the Hercules' club plant, a deciduous shrub or small tree native to North America. This plant is valued for its various health benefits, including its potential to reduce inflammation, improve digestion, and exhibit antimicrobial properties, which can aid in the treatment of various ailments. The therapeutic actions of Zanthoxylum clava-herculis var. fruticosum include its ability to stimulate the digestive system, relieve pain, and exhibit anti-inflammatory effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, volatile oils, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
